title: Load Balancer Decision Cheat Sheet — Scope & Architecture Map
purpose: Visualizes PCA Load Balancer Selection Matrix: External Application Load Balancer (Global/Regional L7 HTTP/S) vs External Proxy Network Load Balancer (Global L4 TCP/SSL) vs External Passthrough Network Load Balancer (Regional L4 UDP/TCP non-proxy) vs Internal Load Balancers.
routing_rationale: Selecting the correct Google Cloud Load Balancer requires evaluating three precise criteria: Layer 7 HTTP/S vs Layer 4 TCP/UDP, Global Anycast edge termination vs Regional routing, and whether client IP preservation is mandatory.

nodes.label: Traffic: HTTP / HTTPS / gRPC?
nodes.detail: Requires URL path routing, TLS termination, Cloud CDN caching, and Cloud Armor WAF.

nodes.label: Traffic: Raw TCP / UDP / VoIP?
nodes.detail: Non-HTTP protocols, gaming UDP streams, or requires direct client source IP preservation.

nodes.label: External Application LB (Global)
nodes.detail: Single Anycast IP; terminates TLS at edge; routes to backends across multiple regions.

nodes.label: External Proxy Network LB
nodes.detail: Terminates non-HTTP TCP/SSL traffic at Google edge; routes over private fiber.

nodes.label: External Passthrough Network LB
nodes.detail: Preserves client IP directly; supports UDP; routes traffic directly without proxy hops.

nodes.label: Internal Application LB
nodes.detail: Internal microservice-to-microservice traffic routing within Shared VPC subnets.

edges.label: 3. L4 TCP + Global Anycast -> Proxy NLB
4. L4 UDP / Preserve IP -> Passthrough NLB

steps.title: Layer 7 Ingress Selection
steps.action: HTTP/HTTPS traffic routes to External ALB for edge caching or Internal ALB for microservices.
steps.why_traversal: Provides URL-based routing and edge security policies.

steps.title: Layer 4 Ingress Selection
steps.action: TCP/UDP traffic routes to Proxy NLB for Anycast or Passthrough NLB for direct IP preservation.
steps.why_traversal: Supports gaming, streaming, and custom non-HTTP enterprise protocols.

scenarios.label: Configured Application LB for UDP Gaming Traffic
scenarios.root_cause: External Application Load Balancer only supports HTTP, HTTPS, and gRPC; dropped all UDP packets.
scenarios.recovery: Use External Passthrough Network Load Balancer for UDP gaming and streaming protocols.

scenarios.label: Quota exhausted
scenarios.root_cause: A project or regional quota reaches its allocation limit.
scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of the affected resource or dependency.
scenarios.recovery: Reduce load, restore the dependency, and add a tested prevention.

scenarios.label: Dependency unavailable
scenarios.root_cause: A required API or downstream dependency is unavailable.
scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of the affected resource or dependency.
scenarios.recovery: Reduce load, restore the dependency, and add a tested prevention.
